title: Stacked modality
summary: Guess about the past with `-mIş olmalı`, `-mIş olabilir` and `-mIş olamaz`, say what will have happened with `-mIş olacak`, imagine unlikely cases with `-(y)AcAk olsa`, look back at what didn't happen with `-mIş olsaydı`, and read long modal chains.
canDo: Make confident and cautious guesses about what happened in the past
Say what will have happened, or will be happening, at a moment in the future
Imagine an unlikely case, and say what would have been different
Read the stacked modal verbs of reports and academic prose
